claim_es: Low intake and certain disorders or drugs may cause inadequate magnesium; routine supplementation for generic wellness is not universally justified.
applicability: Nutritional status, renal safety and specific studied indications
mandatory_precautions: Supplemental magnesium adult UL in US is 350 mg/day, not an intake target; age/jurisdiction-specific limits differ
Tetracycline/quinolone antibiotics and oral bisphosphonates have absorption interactions
Count antacids and laxatives containing magnesium; gastrointestinal adverse effects
proposed_rule_decision: Require elemental magnesium accounting and indication-specific review
notes: Source-linked critical appraisal intake; individual primary papers and jurisdictional guidelines require further verification.
